messages:
maya: Heads-up — kicking off deploy for model-routing v3 now. Will enable feature flag `model-route-v3` gradually across cohorts. Deploy window 03:00-04:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy started by maya for service=model-router image=router:v3. healthchecks=enabled. CI status=green.
sam: copy — what’s the ramp plan? percentages + time slices?
maya: plan: 0->5% (10m) -> 25% (30m) -> 50% (45m) -> 100% (2h). Cohorts: canary EU-west, then US-east, then global. Pin v2 for critical customers: customer_cohort=gold.
jia: rollback triggers? latency > 20% above baseline or error-rate > 1% for 2 consecutive windows (5m). Also watch token generation p95.
ops-lead: added release notes draft: https://confluence/internal/release-notes/model-router-v3 (short link). Also, ops: please have quick-disable ready: `/ff toggle model-route-v3 off --force` (ops-only).
sam: can we gate by route header too? want safe fallback for low-traffic endpoints.
maya: yes — routing policy set to header-fallback for X-Canary; default fallback -> router:v2. Config snippet: ```yaml
feature_flag: model-route-v3
ramp:
  - percent: 5
    window: 10m
  - percent: 25
    window: 30m
fallback: router:v2
pin_customers: ["gold"]
```
deploy-bot: canary healthchecks ok at +6m (requests=1200, errors=0.2%, p95_latency=120ms).
sam: good. I’ll watch latency graphs, have alert thresholds set. If we see >15% p95 increase, we fast-disable.
ops-lead: FYI prod-telemetry has a small spike in 95th at +18m (15% up) — keeping an eye.
deploy-bot: automon: latency spike detected at +19m (p95 +22%). threshold breach.
jia: seeing increased retries from a subset of downstream workers in US-east. Could be model tokenization change. Recommend pause ramp and disable for US-east.
maya: agree — pausing ramp. Sam, ops-lead, can one of you execute the disable for the US-east cohort?
sam: executing now: `/ff set model-route-v3 --region us-east --percent 0` -> response: OK.
deploy-bot: feature-flag update applied region=us-east percent=0 by sam.
ops-lead: monitoring — US-east p95 back to baseline within 2m.
maya: do we want full rollback to v2 or continue staged rollout with fixes?
ja: root cause likely tokenization edge-case; patch in train. ETA 90m. Suggest roll forward with EU and gold customers only, pin gold to v2?
sam: I vote partial rollforward: keep global at 5% excluding US-east until patch. Also pin gold to v2 for safety.
maya: okay applying pins and region exclusions. Running command: `/ff set model-route-v3 --percent 5 --exclude-region us-east` and `/ff pin customer:gold router:v2`
deploy-bot: commands applied. percent=5 exclude_region=[us-east] pinned_customers=[gold]
ops-lead: creating postmortem note and adding to the release thread. Will hold final 100% roll until patch validated. :memo:
maya: thanks all — will update release notes and follow up after the patch. If anyone sees new anomalies, ping here or call. :thumbsup:
